name: bunbun-authoring
description: Local Skills-only authoring for Bunbun 0.2 lesson-draft packets and bounded repairs.

interface.shortDescription: Create one strict Bunbun lesson draft.
interface.longDescription: Composes the approved Story Sheet, Reverse Trainer, and Story Coach responsibilities over a versioned Bunbun packet and returns one strict JSON result for local validation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bunbun-lesson-authoring with the Bunbun authoring packet I provide and return exactly one strict JSON result.
